Continental Reinsurance Holdings Limited has announced a strengthened investment proposition ahead of its planned listing on the Botswana Stock Exchange, following the approval of its Supplementary Prospectus by the BSE. The Supplementary Prospectus confirms that the promoter-controlled existing shareholder vehicle, ACA Cornerstone Limited, will retain its entire 14.8 per cent shareholding rather than exit the business as originally contemplated. It also incorporates audit-reviewed interim financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, reflecting improved profitability and strong underwriting performance. Under the revised offer structure, ACA Cornerstone will retain all 253,951,336 of its existing shares. This represents approximately 11.9 per cent of Continental Reinsurance Holdings’ enlarged issued share capital following completion of the offer, assuming all contemplated new shares are issued. ACA Cornerstone has also provided a formal undertaking, subject to specified conditions, to retain these shares for a minimum of five years following listing. Group Managing Director of Continental Reinsurance Holdings, Mutsunge Lawrence Nazare, said: “We have engaged closely with investors and taken on board their feedback. The revised offer reflects that engagement and reinforces our long-term investment proposition. ACA Cornerstone’s decision to remain invested, together with its five-year share retention undertaking, demonstrates continued commitment to the business and its future. We believe this strengthens alignment between existing and incoming shareholders as we prepare for our listing on the Botswana Stock Exchange.” The Supplementary Prospectus also incorporates the Group’s audit-reviewed financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. Profit before tax increased by approximately 352 per cent to P79.2m, compared with P17.5m in the corresponding period of 2025. Profit after tax rose by approximately 902 per cent to P64.4m from P6.4m, while insurance revenue grew by 2.4 per cent to P1.213bn. As at 30 June 2026, the Group reported total assets of P3.27bn and total equity of P1.43bn. The Public Offer will remain open until Friday, 20 November 2026, with the Group’s listing on the BSE Main Board scheduled for 10 December 2026, subject to the applicable listing requirements. The offer price remains unchanged at P1.00 per share, with the Group continuing to target $30m in new growth capital through the offer for subscription. The firm said the Supplementary Prospectus should be read together with the original Prospectus dated 4 August 2026. Investors who submitted applications before publication of the Supplementary Prospectus may maintain, amend or withdraw their applications. The deadline for amendments or withdrawals is 11 November 2026. Applications for which no amendment or withdrawal notice is received by this date will remain in place without amendment, the firm added. Odinaka Anudu
